name: Max 10 Date Text
definition: Specifies a date expressed either in the YY-MM format, YYYY-MM format, or in the YYYY-MM-DD format.
format: Required format is 4 digits, then the character "-", then 2 digits, then the character "-", then 2 digits; or 2 digits, then the character "-", then 2 digits; or 4 digits, then the character "-", then 2 digits
